name: r/LocalLLM on Reddit: Pi coding agent is amazing (or how I learned to stop worrying and leave OpenCode)
description: How could the model performance be affected so drastically by the agentic framework? I'm not saying it's not possible, I think we've all seen how tweaks and changes to subtle things can make big differences in output, but this seems strange. ... Opencodes system prompt is huuuge, might be something in there that accounts for the drastic differences? ... Yes. Pi has a super tiny system prompt and 4-5 simple tools.
